blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Face-to-face classes are suspended in several schools in Luzon and Visayas on Tuesday, October 27, due to various reasons. The Philippine Science High School (PSHS) – Main Campus in Quezon City suspended its classes on October 26 and 27, 2026 “due to increasing reports of illness among students.” The main campus said classes will shift to an online learning setup on October 28 and 29, 2026.
